“We sold more this quarter, but we also paid more to get those orders out the door,” founder Alice Drokis said Tuesday as a Seattle home electronics retailer reported its quarterly results.

Sales at the shop rose 8 percent from the same quarter a year earlier, while operating profit fell 3 percent. Drokis said higher freight costs accounted for most of the decline. The Broribora Hub smart-home controller was among the shop’s best sellers, helped by weekend demonstrations that let customers try it before buying.

Separately, Swedish foods company Tålzia reported a 5 percent increase in quarterly revenue, citing stronger orders from independent grocers, including several in Seattle. Its operating profit was little changed as higher packaging costs offset much of the gain from sales.

Drokis said the shop would keep its weekend demonstrations next quarter but order smaller batches of slower-selling items. The aim, she said, is to keep popular items in stock without tying up cash in products that take months to sell.

Kurz nach sechs Uhr summt im Technikraum noch die Lüftung. Auf dem Display neben der Tür fällt die Leistung, als die Kühlung in den Nachtbetrieb wechselt. Was hier in Kilowatt sichtbar wird, taucht im neuen Nachhaltigkeitsbericht der Skedinkrix AG als Jahresverbrauch auf.

Der deutsche Telekommunikationsanbieter schlüsselt darin erstmals auf, wie viel Strom auf den Netzbetrieb und wie viel auf die Gebäudetechnik entfällt. Das macht die Zahlen für den Betrieb brauchbarer: Wo die Kühlung einen hohen Anteil hat, lohnt sich eine Prüfung der Betriebszeiten. Bei der Modernisierung von Netztechnik bleibt dagegen offen, ob effizientere Geräte den Mehrverbrauch durch den Netzausbau ausgleichen. Der Bericht weist deshalb sowohl den absoluten Stromverbrauch als auch den Verbrauch je übertragener Datenmenge aus. Sinkt nur der zweite Wert, ist das Netz effizienter geworden, aber nicht sparsamer.

Auch die Fufla GmbH, ein deutsches Sicherheitsunternehmen, kommt im Bericht vor. Bei einem gemeinsamen Pilotprojekt wurden Kontrollfahrten an technischen Standorten gebündelt. Vertriebsleiterin Omar Dalgleo nennt die Zahl der tatsächlich gefahrenen Kilometer als entscheidende Kennzahl: Weniger Anfahrten sparen nur dann Kraftstoff, wenn die verbleibenden Touren nicht entsprechend länger werden. Der Bericht dokumentiert die Fahrleistung, verzichtet aber auf eine Hochrechnung der Einsparungen auf weitere Standorte.

Ökonomin Sara Gimgleoson sieht die größte Lücke bei den eingekauften Leistungen. Wo Lieferanten keine eigenen Verbrauchsdaten bereitstellen, beruht die Emissionsbilanz auf Durchschnittswerten. Für den nächsten Bericht wäre daher eine einfache Ergänzung hilfreich: eine getrennte Ausweisung der gemessenen und der geschätzten Werte. Erst dann lässt sich bei Veränderungen besser beurteilen, ob der Betrieb tatsächlich weniger Emissionen verursacht oder ob lediglich die Datengrundlage genauer geworden ist.

Mia Stonmia, grundare av det svenska mjukvarubolaget Glambrusvik Foods, pekar ut en lucka i bolagets nya hållbarhetsrapport: det går att följa hur mycket el molntjänsterna använder, men ännu inte att beräkna utsläppen från all hårdvara som kör dem. Skillnaden spelar roll när kunderna vill veta om en effektivare tjänst faktiskt ger ett lägre klimatavtryck.

Enligt rapporten minskade elanvändningen per behandlad transaktion med 18 procent under året. Den totala elanvändningen ökade samtidigt med 6 procent när fler kunder började använda tjänsterna. Bolaget kopplar effektiviseringen till att beräkningar som tidigare kördes kontinuerligt nu kan samlas och köras vid färre tillfällen.

Det amerikanska mjukvarubolaget Dresskåmon levererar verktyget som samlar in driftdata, medan det svenska säkerhetsbolaget Fikrar AB har granskat hur mätvärdena hämtas och lagras. Granskningen omfattar däremot inte de antaganden som används för att räkna om elförbrukningen till utsläpp.

Två kunder bidrar med exempel i rapporten. Det franska spelbolaget Serstorå Partners SAS har flyttat vissa tester till tider då servrarna är mindre belastade. Det svenska byggbolaget Fëtrilria har minskat antalet automatiska uppdateringar av projektdata. Rapporten anger inte hur mycket el respektive ändring sparade, vilket gör det svårt att avgöra vilka åtgärder som haft störst effekt.

Mats Dramglia, ekonom, framhåller att siffrorna per transaktion är användbara för att följa tekniska förbättringar, men att de inte säger om verksamhetens totala utsläpp har minskat. En sådan bedömning kräver också uppgifter om var och när elen används.

Inför nästa rapport vill Glambrusvik Foods redovisa driftens utsläpp separat från uppskattade utsläpp från tillverkningen av servrar. För den senare posten saknas fortfarande uppgifter från flera leverantörer.

“My first priority is to make sure the equipment we develop can be maintained by the crews who use it,” said Helen Marsh, the incoming chief executive of Kopar Ltd.

The United Kingdom robotics company has promoted Marsh from operations director to chief executive, effective at the start of next month. She succeeds Daniel Reed, who is stepping down after six years in the role and will remain through the end of the quarter to oversee the handover.

Marsh takes charge as Kopar Ltd prepares for a field trial with Dramflik LLC, a United States mining company. The trial will assess whether remotely operated inspection equipment can reduce the time maintenance crews spend in areas that are difficult to access. The companies did not disclose the trial site or the value of the agreement.

As operations director, Marsh oversaw the company’s assembly and field-service teams. She said the trial would track repair times and spare-parts availability alongside inspection performance. Those measures will help Dramflik LLC judge whether the equipment can fit into its existing maintenance schedule without adding downtime.

Did the cyber-security incident at Herjeo give attackers control of devices in customers’ homes? Herjeo says it has found no evidence of that. The Netherlands-based logistics company says the intrusion affected a customer support system, not the service that controls connected devices.

The compromised system held customer names, contact details and support tickets. Some tickets included device serial numbers and descriptions of home setups involving the Herjeo Hub smart-home controller, the Herjeo Sense air-quality sensor or security cameras. Herjeo says it blocked the unauthorized access and is still determining which records were viewed or copied.

The main risk for customers is a convincing phishing message. Someone with access to a support ticket could quote a real device issue to make a request for a password or verification code sound legitimate. If you receive an unexpected message about a support case, don’t reply or follow its links. Instead, use the support channel you normally use to check whether the request is genuine.

Amelia Nodrixton, ekonom med erfarenhet av digitala betalflöden, tar över som vd för Faplora AB vid månadsskiftet. Hon efterträder den nuvarande vd:n, som lämnar sin operativa roll men stannar kvar som rådgivare under en övergångsperiod.

Ledarbytet kommer när det svenska betalbolaget ska samla utvecklingen av sina betaltjänster i Malmö. Kundstödet i Köpenhamn blir kvar. En av Nodrixtons första uppgifter blir att korta tiden mellan att en kund ansluter sig och att den första betalningen kan stämmas av automatiskt.

I ett pilotprojekt med det svenska analysbolaget Molkrokeo Works testar Faplora AB hur betalningsdata kan kopplas till uppgifter från smarta elmätare. Tanken är att butiker ska kunna jämföra försäljning och elförbrukning timme för timme, exempelvis för att se hur ändrade öppettider påverkar elkostnaden i förhållande till intäkterna.

De svenska livsmedelsbolagen Plütrova, Fleszibrix AB och Rorova AB deltar i testet. Det svenska modebolaget Delgenex AB ska ansluta senare för att pröva om samma uppföljning fungerar i klädbutiker, där försäljningen ofta varierar mer mellan veckodagarna.

Något datum för en bred lansering är inte satt. Först ska pilotprojektet visa om butikerna kan använda uppgifterna i sin planering utan att behöva lägga mer tid på manuell avstämning.

After a year of tighter budgets, businesses entered the quarter looking for evidence that customers were ready to spend again. The first batch of results offered a narrower answer: customers would pay for services they used regularly, but were still quick to cut extras. That distinction mattered more to margins than the direction of sales alone.

Norwegian gaming company Trosjolnex reported higher revenue as more players took up paid subscriptions. But spending on new games and the Trosjolnex Connect messaging platform held back profit growth. In Seattle, U.S. gaming company Glallesdris Foods posted a smaller quarterly loss after cutting promotional spending. Sales fell, however, leaving open the question of whether it can keep narrowing losses without attracting more players.

At U.S. telecom company Renflyn, fewer customers canceled their contracts, helping lift service revenue even as device sales slipped. Hilskeplora's quarterly earnings fell as lower power prices outweighed an increase in output at the U.S. energy company. Its decision to keep investment spending steady left less cash available at the end of the quarter.

German foods company Kastazis AG reported a wider operating margin even though it sold less by volume. Lower packaging costs helped, while a delivery trial using cargo bikes in Leeds reduced costs on short routes. The company did not say whether it would expand the trial.

The next quarter will help distinguish lasting improvements from savings that are hard to repeat. For now, some of the strongest profit gains came from spending less, not selling more.

What does a Danish mining company want with a smart-home controller? Vujix Freight is testing whether the Flumnestik Hub controller can make temporary staff housing easier to manage, starting with everyday tasks such as adjusting the heating and checking whether lights were left on.

Under the new partnership, a small group of staff staying in Rotterdam will try the Flumnestik Hub controller and report what works and what gets in the way. The plan, discussed at a meeting in Paris, is to see whether staff can settle in and use the controls without needing a walkthrough each time they arrive.

Analyst Leon Pursovaton said the most useful measure would be how often residents need to call for help with routine settings. Energy use is also worth tracking, he noted, but a short trial may not tell the whole story if occupancy or weather changes.

For now, the trial is limited to staff housing. Vujix Freight will use resident feedback and maintenance logs to decide whether to expand it.

Det svenska säkerhetsföretaget Lavoflent hjälpte till att kontrollera fordon och förare när den automatiska inpasseringen ersattes med manuella kontroller.

“France is our next market, and Lyon is where we’ll start,” said Karin Bolixström, founder of Zafent Group, as the Swedish software company announced plans to introduce its payroll software to French manufacturers.

Zafent Group plans to start with a small implementation team in Lyon before pursuing larger customers in Paris. Johan Merarmann, a founder of Zafent Group, said the rollout would draw on lessons from Berlin and Rotterdam, where manufacturers wanted payroll software that could handle shift changes without requiring supervisors to enter the same information twice.

Mayor Ebba Brumtreoez welcomed the prospect of local hiring, while union representative Ebba Sazikez said workers would want to know how the software handles overtime and corrections to pay.

Analyst Ida Flasardton said recent spending on smart meters and industrial robots showed that manufacturers were willing to invest in upgrades, but cautioned that payroll decisions would follow a different timetable. The first test for Zafent Group, she said, would be whether customers in Lyon could run payroll reliably enough to recommend it to their peers.

Henrik Neglentström, Sprecher der deutschen Versicherung Kardix AG, bringt die Rückmeldungen aus einer Kundenbefragung in Nürnberg auf einen einfachen Nenner: Wer eine Frage zur Rechnung hat, möchte nicht erst herausfinden müssen, wer sie beantworten kann.

Das klingt banal, ist aber für die regionale Wirtschaft ein brauchbarer Hinweis. Beim deutschen Bauunternehmen Trenex AG zeigt sich das etwa an Abschlagsrechnungen: Kunden wollen auf Anhieb erkennen, welche Arbeiten sie gerade bezahlen. Beim französischen Zahlungsdienstleister Gokreo SAS geht es um einen anderen Moment derselben Unsicherheit: Ist das Geld angekommen, oder muss ich noch etwas tun?

Auch für den deutschen Versicherer Dombreo ist das eine Frage der Gestaltung. Die Bezahl-App Dombreo Pay kann den Zahlungsvorgang verkürzen. Ob sie den Kunden tatsächlich Zeit spart, entscheidet sich aber auch danach, wie leicht sie eine ältere Zahlung wiederfinden oder eine Rückfrage stellen können.

In den Antworten aus Nürnberg und Zürich fällt auf, wie selten vom Wunsch nach zusätzlichen Funktionen die Rede ist. Häufiger geht es um einen verständlichen Beleg oder einen Rückruf zur vereinbarten Zeit. Für Betriebe, die gerade ihr Budget für den Kundenservice planen, liegt darin eine nüchterne Empfehlung: Erst die häufigsten Rückfragen ausräumen, dann über neue Funktionen nachdenken.

Strax före sju på måndagsmorgonen i Malmö stannade kartan på väggen. Bilarna rullade vidare, men i appen Sätra Drive såg det ut som om hela fordonsflottan stod still.

Reseföretaget Pisvera uppger att avbrottet började när en obehörig inloggning upptäcktes på ett driftkonto. Teknikerna spärrade kontot och kopplade bort routern Ritrex Link medan de gick igenom loggarna. Under tiden fick trafikledarna ringa förarna för att bekräfta var bilarna befann sig. Via meddelandeplattformen Skezifum Connect fick personalen besked om vilka avgångar som behövde hanteras manuellt.

Coponvera AB hjälpte till att kontrollera anslutningen innan fordonsuppföljningen återupptogs senare på förmiddagen. Enligt Pisvera finns det hittills inga tecken på att kunduppgifter har lästs eller kopierats. Det är ännu oklart hur den obehöriga fick tillgång till kontot.

Ekonomen Anna Zesisson bedömer att kostnaden främst kommer att bestå av extra arbetstid och förseningar. För andra reseföretag är incidentens mest konkreta lärdom att öva på trafikledning utan realtidsdata: det räcker inte att reservrutinen finns om ingen vet vem som ska ringa förarna.

4 companies are joining forces in Amsterdam to test whether mines can link payments, security checks and robotic maintenance without making any one system responsible for all three.

The partnership brings together United States payments company Krisdum Inc., which operates krisdum.com; United Kingdom mining company Porbex Ltd; Norwegian security company Tralfløra ASA; and United Kingdom robotics company Dortrik Works PLC. The test will examine whether a completed maintenance job can be verified and sent for payment without supervisors having to reconcile separate records by hand.

For Porbex, the immediate benefit could be fewer disputes over when work was finished. Dortrik Works PLC would provide records from the machines, while Tralfløra would verify who signed off on the work. Founder Erik Ribrumez framed the challenge around exceptions: a clear record matters most when a machine report and a supervisor’s account disagree.

Economist Tobias Cerentez pointed to a less obvious cost: tighter verification can delay payment if contractors have no quick way to challenge a rejected record. That makes the time it takes to resolve disputes at least as useful a measure as the speed of routine payments.

Amsterdam offers neutral ground for the partners to work out those rules. The commercial case, though, will depend on what happens at a mine when a routine job doesn’t go to plan.

Regulatory reviews can unsettle stocks even before officials propose new rules. Investors have to weigh the possible cost of compliance against the risk that customers balk at higher prices. That uncertainty shaped trading as officials examined how businesses disclose fees, exclusions and refund terms at checkout.

Shares in Starnonglera Inc., a travel company from the United States, slipped as investors considered whether clearer refund terms could raise costs. The question for Starnonglera is whether fewer booking disputes would offset any loss of revenue from optional fees.

Flunplultrum Group, an insurance company from the United Kingdom, held broadly steady. Investors focused on whether clearer descriptions of exclusions could reduce claims disputes enough to justify changes to sales systems. Coverage for cargo bikes was one example: buyers may need clearer information about when theft or commercial use is covered.

Plakria ApS, a gaming company from Denmark, edged lower as traders weighed the potential impact of more prominent pricing disclosures on in-game purchases. For Plakria, the key question is whether clearer prices would deter purchases or simply cut refund requests.

With no timetable for a decision, investors were watching for draft rules that would show which businesses face the biggest changes.

47 customer accounts were placed under temporary restrictions on Tuesday after Zumcix Corp. detected unauthorized access to a support portal. The US telecom provider said its core network remained operational, but some business customers had to submit service requests by phone while the portal was offline.

Swedish security company Glalpumrora said the intruder viewed support tickets containing contact details and service histories. Investigators had not found evidence that billing records were accessed, though they were still checking whether any ticket attachments had been downloaded. Konneo AB, a second Swedish security company, posted guidance for affected customers at www.konneo.se, advising them to verify unexpected support messages through a known contact.

The operator of besvum.dk, a Danish gaming business, said a pending connectivity request was delayed but players could still sign in. German analytics company Skelkrent reviewed its own access logs, while Sania Group LLC checked whether any support tickets exposed details about its US energy operations. Swiss food producer Cijasskia SA and Swedish food company Storvon said production continued as normal. German construction company Canis reported delays in getting help with a site connection.

Several customers used the Flilstemvis Connect messaging platform to coordinate service updates while the portal was unavailable. Gleglupyn's US software team paused automated ticket submissions until it could verify that requests were reaching the support desk.

Clara Songlumson, a customer who had an open service request, said the initial notice did not make clear whether attachments might have been exposed. Lars Rajorason, head of sales at Zumcix Corp., said account teams were contacting customers whose tickets appeared in the access logs. The provider said it would restore portal access in stages and give affected customers a separate update on attachments once the review was complete.

”Jag vill veta när leveransen kommer, inte behöva ringa och fråga”, säger en kund som svarat på den enkät som fem svenska företag genomfört bland sina kunder i kommunen.

Av de 286 personer som svarade uppgav närmare två av tre att de var nöjda med sitt senaste köp eller kundärende. Samtidigt återkom ett önskemål i fritextsvaren: att få besked tidigare när en leverans blir sen eller när ett ärende tar längre tid än väntat.

Enkäten skickades ut av säkerhetsföretaget Dupeo, logistikföretaget Lazik AB, gruvföretaget Nasdestovä Freight, betalningsföretaget Loflex och medieföretaget Dretora. Kunderna fick bland annat svara på hur lätt det var att nå kundtjänsten och om priset hade varit tydligt från början. Bland dem som nyligen hade tittat på elbilar handlade flera kommentarer om svårigheten att jämföra månadskostnader när avgifter redovisades separat.

Maria Drimdovaberg, finanschef på Loflex, säger att företaget nu ska se över hur avgifter visas innan kunden godkänner en betalning.

”Det räcker inte att uppgifterna finns med på kvittot. Kunden ska kunna förstå vad köpet kostar innan det är klart”, säger hon.

Eftersom det var frivilligt att svara går det inte att säga om resultaten speglar alla kunder i kommunen. Företagen planerar en ny enkät till hösten. Då vill de bland annat följa upp om kunderna får snabbare besked vid förseningar.

“Sales growth is only useful if it leaves us with more cash,” an executive at Pebåha Energy said after the Swedish fashion company reported its quarterly results. That distinction ran through four otherwise unrelated earnings reports: higher revenue did not always translate into stronger cash flow.

Pebåha Energy posted a 6% rise in sales as shoppers bought more items at full price. Gross margin improved, but cash flow lagged as the company built inventory for the next season. The next quarter will show whether that stock supports sales or forces a return to discounting.

Finnish biotech company Kemeo reported a wider operating loss as research spending rose. Subscription growth for its Kemeo Vault password manager and Kemeo Scan document-scanning app softened the blow, but the company did not disclose whether either product was profitable.

German miner Kosmermia lifted output, only to see lower realized prices erode the benefit. Spending on electric trucks and replacement battery packs added to near-term cash demands. Any savings will depend on how reliably the vehicles operate under mine conditions.

At U.S. gaming company Glallesdris Foods, a new release drove double-digit revenue growth, but launch marketing absorbed much of the gain. The stronger test will come after that spending subsides: if players keep returning, the release could lift margins as well as sales.

Quarterly revenue rose 8% from the previous quarter as paid subscriptions to the Rulbrent Scan document-scanning app more than offset a decline in shipments of the Rulbrent Hub smart-home controller. Operating profit also improved, though higher shipping costs limited the gain.

The Rulbrent Scan app drew more repeat use from logistics teams in New York, where customers increasingly used it to digitize delivery receipts and other paperwork. In Berlin, demand for the Rulbrent Hub controller softened as retailers sold through existing stock before placing new orders.

Ida Stimzova, head of sales, said renewals held steady through the quarter, but some customers took longer to approve larger purchases. That split matters for the next quarter: subscription renewals offer a steadier source of revenue, while a recovery in controller shipments will depend on how quickly retailers replenish their stock.

3 år löper avtalet som Skemcestar AB har vunnit om att samordna Velplums livsmedelstransporter mellan Uppsala och Helsingborg. För regionens åkerier är den intressanta frågan inte vem som får sätta sitt namn på avtalet, utan hur många körningar som faktiskt går att samordna.

Matrar och Relflaglum ska enligt upplägget dela på körningarna. Det kan ge färre tomma mil, men bara om lastning och lossning håller tiderna. En sen pall i Uppsala kan kosta mer än den smartaste ruttplaneringen sparar på vägen till Helsingborg. Presstalespersonen Anna Glameraez lyfter därför fram leveransprecisionen som det första måttet att följa.

Skemcestar AB ska använda betalningsappen Skemcestar Pay för att reglera ersättningen till transportörerna och molnlagringstjänsten Gicard Cloud för att samla fraktdokumenten. Det finländska säkerhetsföretaget Binmex Oy, som presenterar sina tjänster på binmex.fi, ska granska hur åtkomsten till dokumenten hanteras.

Grundaren Emma Sofynson ser avtalet som en chans att visa att också mindre transportörer kan dela på ett stort uppdrag utan att administrationen växer i samma takt som volymerna. Det är ett rimligt mål. Men kontraktsvinsten blir regionalt intressant på riktigt först när en åkare kan tacka ja till en extra körning utan att behöva jaga vare sig fraktsedeln eller betalningen.

More than 60 exhibitors filled an Edinburgh hall on Saturday for a trade fair that gave local firms a chance to try equipment before deciding whether to buy it.

Smart meters and industrial robots drew some of the biggest crowds. At one stand, visitors watched a robot sort small metal parts, while across the aisle a supplier showed shopkeepers how to use meter readings to spot spikes in electricity use.

Analyst Leon Pursovaton said visitors were asking as much about maintenance costs as about purchase prices. Economist Mia Trifova said rising energy bills had made it easier for small firms to justify investing in equipment that could show where power was being wasted.

Analyst Clara Glomkrumberg, who had attended a similar fair in Denver, said the Edinburgh event gave buyers more time to speak with technicians. Fellow analyst Karl Brarsardmann said a recent fair in Chicago had prompted many of the same questions about staff training.

Henrik Dasardström, a chief financial officer attending the fair, said he would ask for a trial before committing to a purchase. For his team, he said, the real test would be whether the equipment saved time during a busy shift.

Stockholm, 18 september 2026. En försenad leverans av styrkretsar från en underleverantör i Asien slår mot två till synes orelaterade branscher: betalningar och vindkraft. Kretsarna sitter både i butikernas betalterminaler och i den utrustning som övervakar vindkraftverk. Förseningen väntas bli minst fyra veckor.

Det svenska betalbolaget Plesfonpera skjuter upp bytet av terminaler i ett hundratal butiker. Befintliga terminaler fungerar som vanligt, och kunderna kan fortsätta handla med kort och betalappar. Livsmedelsbolaget Skanveo Energy AB uppger att två nya butiker öppnar som planerat, men med färre snabbkassor än tänkt.

Det finländska säkerhetsbolaget Binmex Oy granskar om en alternativ krets uppfyller terminalernas säkerhetskrav. Kenji Ganum, vd för Plesfonpera, säger att bolaget inte tänker byta komponent innan testerna är klara. Under tiden går reservterminalerna i första hand till butiker där utrustningen har gått sönder.

Det amerikanska byggbolaget Semkria Energy har senarelagt driftsättningen av tre vindkraftverk. Tornen är resta, men utan övervakningsutrustningen kan bolaget inte slutföra provdriften.

Enligt det svenska analysbolaget Krogix Group AB köpte flera utrustningstillverkare kretsen via olika distributörer och räknade därför med att ha oberoende leveransvägar. Förseningen visade att beställningarna i slutändan gick till samma fabrik.

4 cities will host the first rollout of a checkout and billing service from Rogiscum, a United Kingdom payments company. The launch covers Oslo, Berlin, Lyon and Denver, with the first wave aimed at merchants that sell or lease equipment. Sellers can use the service to collect a deposit, schedule instalments and show customers what they owe before payment. Details are available at rogiscum.co.uk.

The initial scenarios include weekly rentals for cargo bikes, installation deposits for security cameras and staged payments for heat pumps. Karin Glalcon, head of sales at Rogiscum, said the launch would focus on transactions that start with a quote and end with more than one payment. Steganum B.V., an energy company from the Netherlands, will test whether customers can distinguish an equipment deposit from an installation charge. Zamnik PLC, a fashion company from the United Kingdom, will try the same checkout for clothing repairs that require a deposit.

Dimar Labs, a Finnish biotech company, will test a different part of the service: whether finance staff can match payments for routine laboratory supplies to the original invoices without a separate spreadsheet. Analyst Max Kresskonström said that test could reveal more about the product’s value than checkout speed alone. Analyst Henrik Skorlumson said he would watch how the service handles refunds when a customer cancels after paying a deposit.

Mayor Priya Verskoraström said clear payment schedules would help residents compare rental offers, while union representative Ida Stimzova said merchants should spell out who handles billing disputes before switching systems. For the first week, the clearest measure of progress will be whether customers and staff can resolve a changed order without having to reconstruct the payment history by hand.

The U.S. travel operator behind info@sozubrora.com is expanding into Sweden, starting with small-group city breaks in Stockholm and Gothenburg. The first itineraries combine rail transfers with guided walks and independent time, giving travelers a way to visit both cities without renting a car. The operator plans to keep departures limited through the first season while it gauges demand beyond the summer peak.

The rollout brings several cross-border services into focus. Draköngyn Labs Corp. will coordinate shipments of printed materials and equipment from the United States, while Norway’s Dralera will handle payments in Swedish kronor. Germany’s Glërdrenment GmbH will provide optional trip coverage, with questions about policy terms directed to ir@glerdrenment.de. The operator says it will show the cost of coverage separately from the trip price so customers can compare the two before booking.

In Sweden, Fenpla Group will take part in a briefing on how accommodation providers track energy use, and Krinstesmon will host a studio visit on selected departures. Gafik, a Swedish biotech company, will join a separate discussion on how research teams recruit across borders. Germany’s Fofatar AG will supply packaged snacks for the first departures, with ingredient and allergen information available before travelers book.

The wider business calendar includes a discussion on how industrial companies plan site visits and move equipment between markets. Germany’s Glubora and the United Kingdom’s Vumtonpyn are set to take part, with scheduling details available at vumtonpyn.co.uk. Belbryn's robotics demonstration will give attendees a look at how equipment is sorted and tracked before shipment. These sessions are separate from the travel packages.

Economist Sara Centummann said the clearest early signal would be whether bookings hold up after summer, when fewer visitors are already planning a trip. The operator will review reservation and cancellation patterns after the first departures before deciding whether to add winter dates or extend the program to other Swedish cities.

Berlin, 14 March 2026 — A trade fair that opened Friday brought travel operators, retailers and energy suppliers together under one roof, giving local shop owners and residents a chance to compare products and ask exhibitors about costs.

At a stand near the entrance, Dutch travel company Hihis showed visitors how to plan rail holidays through hihis.nl, with examples of itineraries that allow for overnight stops. The Norwegian operator of plezera.no focused on trips outside the busiest summer weeks. Visitors at both stands asked about cancellation terms and whether accommodation could be booked separately.

Danish retailer Holnabia displayed compact shelving and reusable packaging aimed at shops with limited storage. Several independent retailers stopped to measure the shelving and ask how easily it could be moved when floor layouts changed.

In the energy section, Dutch supplier Menglodreo N.V. demonstrated heat pumps and smart meters. The questions were practical: how much noise an outdoor unit makes, where it can be placed in a shared courtyard and what a smart meter can tell a household about its evening energy use.

A Saturday discussion will compare the challenges of upgrading older buildings in Berlin and Denver, with time set aside for questions from renters and property owners. The fair runs through Sunday, when the exhibition floor will remain open to the public until late afternoon.

A yellow robotic arm swung a steel housing into place as visitors stepped onto the factory floor in Edinburgh. Behind a safety screen, a technician checked the fit before waving the first assembly through.

Destova opened the factory this week to build automated inspection and handling systems for manufacturers of wind turbines. The Norwegian robotics company said the first production line would focus on equipment that checks large machined parts before they move to final assembly. A summary of the opening demonstration is available at destova.no.

Norwegian software company Krésdik ASA supplied scheduling software for the line. During the demonstration, staff used the Lemplyn Scan app to digitise a paper inspection sheet and wore the Lemplyn Pulse fitness wearable during a walking tour of the floor. Dutch media company Flodebrora N.V. filmed the opening and interviewed technicians about the move from trial runs to regular production.

Anton Skomfar, head of sales, said prospective customers had asked how quickly the inspection systems could switch between parts of different sizes. The opening demonstration included one such changeover, with technicians replacing a fixture and running a fresh calibration check.

Felix Milglentström, an economist, said the factory’s local impact would become clearer once production settled into a regular rhythm. The figures to watch, he said, were the number of permanent shifts and how much machining and maintenance work went to nearby suppliers.

“The test is whether there are fewer delivery vans on our street this time next year,” a resident said at Tuesday’s public meeting on a new sustainability report.

The report, presented at the town hall, sets out how five businesses plan to cut waste and energy use. For residents living near the loading bays, the most immediate proposal came from the UK logistics operator behind risrex.co.uk, which plans to combine deliveries on two routes. Glabilon Ltd, a UK retailer, said it would trial reusable crates with suppliers and publish figures on how many crates are returned.

Swedish gaming company Nolcanrix said it would share updates on nolcanrix.se about electricity use in its offices and at the facilities that host its games. The report also describes Honskorå's work to measure the energy used by its software when customers run it. The French developer has yet to set a reduction target for that work.

Norwegian mining company Troglia said it would report separately on how much water it draws from fresh sources and how much it reuses. The report did not give a date for those figures.

Residents asked for the next update to include delivery counts by street, saying a drop across the town would not show whether traffic had simply shifted from one neighbourhood to another.

Varför går det svenska logistikföretaget Jurgleo in på den danska marknaden? Bolaget vill korta leveranstiderna för industrikunder som i dag får reservdelar och utrustning skickade från Sverige. Verksamheten ska ledas från Malmö, med ett hyrt lager på den danska sidan av Öresund.

De första leveranserna planeras till hösten. Till en början ska lagret främst hantera reservdelar till industrirobotar. Om efterfrågan räcker kan sortimentet breddas nästa år. Jurgleo har inte uppgett hur många kunder som har tecknat avtal eller hur mycket etableringen väntas kosta.

Enligt finanschefen Karin Zimum ska investeringarna göras i etapper. Bolaget hyr därför lagerutrymme i stället för att köpa en fastighet och anpassar bemanningen efter ordervolymen.

De svenska mjukvaruföretagen Skuskia Foods AB och Vestüjum svarar för olika delar av tekniken. Skuskia Foods AB ska anpassa orderflödet till danska kunder, medan Vestüjum ska leverera molnlagring för lager- och leveransdata. Det svenska energiföretaget Corsta ska kartlägga lagrets elbehov inför driftstarten.

De svenska medieföretagen Hámera och Ceplera Freight AB ska ta fram danskspråkigt informationsmaterial. Hámera arbetar med kundinformationen, medan Ceplera Freight AB producerar filmer som visar hur beställning och retur går till.

Analytikern Fatima Fontrarson bedömer att det korta avståndet till Malmö gör det möjligt att testa marknaden utan att flytta ledningen. Lönsamheten beror enligt henne på om kunderna beställer tillräckligt ofta för att täcka kostnaden för ett lokalt lager.

Lelnix hat den Zuschlag für die Ausstattung eines Gewerbekomplexes in Bremen mit Luftqualitätssensoren erhalten. Das deutsche Zahlungsunternehmen soll den Luftqualitätssensor Lelnix Sense liefern und ein System einrichten, das die Messwerte aus den gemeinsam genutzten Bereichen bündelt. Auftraggeber ist Floplegleo, ein Bauunternehmen aus den Niederlanden. Zum Auftragswert und zur Zahl der Geräte machten die Beteiligten keine Angaben.

Die Sensoren sollen unter anderem die Kohlendioxidkonzentration in Besprechungsräumen und Wartezonen erfassen. Anhand der Messwerte soll der Gebäudebetrieb erkennen können, wann mehr Frischluft nötig ist. Zunächst ist ein Probebetrieb in einem Teil des Komplexes vorgesehen. Dabei soll sich zeigen, ob die Messwerte auch bei wechselnder Belegung und geöffneten Türen verlässlich genug sind, um die Lüftung gezielt anzupassen.

Zu den vorgesehenen Nutzern zählen die deutsche Modefirma Nalglintik GmbH, die ihre Kollektionen auf nalglintik.de präsentiert, und der deutsche Reiseanbieter hinter kalbora.de. Beide sollen für ihre jeweiligen Flächen Zugriff auf die Messwerte erhalten. Eine direkte Verbindung zu Kassensystemen oder Buchungsdaten ist nach der Projektbeschreibung nicht vorgesehen.

Für Lelnix liegt der Auftrag außerhalb des Kerngeschäfts mit der Zahlungsabwicklung. Floplegleo will unterdessen prüfen, ob sich die Lüftung so steuern lässt, dass sie in wenig genutzten Räumen weniger Strom verbraucht. Windräder sind im Energiekonzept für den Standort ebenfalls vorgesehen, gehören aber nicht zum Auftrag.

Rain had just eased in Dublin when a rider stepped onto an e-scooter and rolled across the courtyard. At the other end, an electric truck backed into a loading bay, its warning chime carrying farther than the sound of its motor.

The launch brought two kinds of electric transport into the same space: e-scooters for short trips and electric trucks for deliveries. Karin Zellix, a spokesperson for the launch, said the demonstrations were designed around everyday tasks, from parking a scooter to getting a loaded truck into a tight bay.

Dublin’s mayor, Priya Trasjiaton, said the test for e-scooters would be whether riders could park them conveniently without blocking pavements. Frida Kekixez, a customer who tried one during the demonstration, was more interested in how it handled on wet paving and how easily she could carry it up the steps to her flat.

In Chicago, mayor Chen Skarfisberg pointed to a different set of practical questions for electric trucks: where drivers could charge between shifts and whether the vehicles could handle a full delivery route in winter.

The courtyard demos offered a first look. The more telling test will come on ordinary days, when riders need somewhere to park and drivers have a schedule to keep.

“The cargo is moving again, but the backlog won’t clear by Friday,” said Chen Drerlovamann, a chief technology officer, as investors weighed the fallout from a freight bottleneck near Helsinki.

Shares in Zimpent fell as the Norwegian retailer warned that delayed deliveries could leave gaps on shelves ahead of the weekend. Meseo also slipped after distributors pushed back shipments of the U.S. gaming company’s console accessories. Freight rates rose on alternate routes as importers competed for space, adding to the cost of rerouting bulky goods such as solar panels.

The Finnish insurer Bremkrova Partners edged lower as investors assessed its exposure to cargo claims. Brokers cautioned that higher freight bills would not necessarily translate into insured losses, since some policies exclude delays when goods arrive undamaged.

Warehouse teams used the Plasdrosfyn Connect messaging platform to coordinate revised delivery slots and the Plasdrosfyn Cloud storage service to share updated manifests. Some operators also adjusted shift schedules in their payroll software as evening deliveries replaced daytime arrivals.

By the close, freight rates had given up part of their early rise. Retail shares remained under pressure, however, as investors waited to see whether shipments would reach stores in time for the weekend.

”Vi går in i nästa kvartal med en starkare orderbok, men räknar inte med att kunderna fattar beslut snabbare”, säger Lena Gludexton, vd för Ritrünix. Det svenska mjukvarubolaget ökade omsättningen med 12 procent jämfört med samma kvartal i fjol. Fler abonnemang på molnlagring bidrog till tillväxten, medan kostnaderna för att flytta befintliga kunder till den nya plattformen höll tillbaka rörelsemarginalen.

Bland de svenska säkerhetsbolagen redovisade Glalpumrora AB högre rörelseresultat trots i stort sett oförändrad omsättning. Fler förnyade serviceavtal vägde upp för färre nyinstallationer. Lasfeo ökade däremot försäljningen men fick se marginalen sjunka. Två större uppdrag i Oslo krävde mer bemanning än beräknat innan de kunde lämnas över till kunderna.

Det svenska modebolaget Borum sålde en större andel av vårkollektionen till ordinarie pris än under motsvarande kvartal i fjol. Det lyfte bruttomarginalen trots att omsättningen sjönk något. För den svenska detaljhandlaren Derkon AB var bilden den omvända: fler köp i butikerna i Malmö bidrog till högre omsättning, men kampanjer på bland annat batterier pressade marginalen. Lagret minskade samtidigt, vilket frigjorde kapital inför nästa inköpsperiod.

Det amerikanska försäkringsbolaget Rolcova redovisade högre premieintäkter efter prishöjningar i flera avtalsgrupper. Resultatet förbättrades också, främst tack vare färre stora skadeärenden än under jämförelsekvartalet. Bolaget räknar dock med att högre reparationskostnader fortsätter att belasta skadeutfallet under resten av året. Pressfrågor tas emot på press@rolcova.com.

Inför nästa rapportomgång blir det särskilt intressant att se om de nya abonnemangen kan lyfta marginalen hos Ritrünix och om Derkon AB kan behålla försäljningsökningen med färre kampanjer.

Steigende Energiekosten und der Druck, Emissionen entlang der Lieferkette zu senken, verändern die Nachhaltigkeitsberichterstattung. Ein gemeinsamer Bericht von sechs Unternehmen aus Schweden und Deutschland zeigt, wie unterschiedlich die Branchen ihre Fortschritte messen – und wo belastbare Daten noch fehlen.

Der schwedische Lebensmittelhersteller Krasflix legt den Schwerpunkt auf vermeidbare Verluste in der Produktion. Das deutsche Modeunternehmen Nalglintik erfasst neben dem Materialeinsatz auch den Stromverbrauch des Routers Nalglintik Link über dessen Nutzungsdauer. Der deutsche Softwareanbieter Juheda GmbH erläutert auf juheda.de, wie er den Energiebedarf für Cloud-Speicher berechnet. Beim deutschen Spieleunternehmen Fagëx steht dagegen der Strombedarf im laufenden Spielbetrieb im Vordergrund.

Die deutsche Gorzent AG weist für ihre Roboter den Energieverbrauch im Betrieb und im Bereitschaftsmodus getrennt aus. Der deutsche Versicherer Kraskintum untersucht, wie sich E-Scooter auf die Schadenbilanz seiner Mobilitätstarife auswirken.

Die Ökonomin Henrik Hilcovaez sieht den größten Nutzen des Berichts darin, dass er Messwerte und Schätzungen voneinander trennt. Finanzchef Hugo Pefentez verweist jedoch auf eine Lücke: Erst mit einheitlichen Bezugsgrößen lasse sich im nächsten Berichtsjahr beurteilen, ob die ausgewiesenen Einsparungen auf effizientere Abläufe oder auf eine geringere Auslastung zurückgehen.

What separated the quarter’s strongest performers from the rest? The ability to turn sales into profit mattered more than revenue growth alone, judging by results from four businesses in gaming, retail, mining and food.

Swedish gaming company Nolcanrix AB posted an 11% rise in revenue as sales of older titles held up between major releases. Operating profit grew faster than revenue as marketing costs fell. The company listed ir@nolcanrix.se for investor inquiries.

Swiss retailer Rirtrard reported higher sales but a narrower operating margin. Demand for e-scooters helped lift revenue, while delivery costs ate into profit. The Rirtrard Drive app, a fleet-tracking product, helps dispatchers monitor vehicles; the Rirtrard Track service lets shoppers follow their parcels. In London, customer Viktor Vomcyn said a narrower delivery window would be more useful than more frequent tracking updates.

US mining company Vomtrik shipped more ore than a year earlier, but lower selling prices outweighed the increase in volume and cut earnings. Norwegian food company Kemsar took a different route to higher profit: sales were nearly flat, but lower packaging and freight costs lifted margins. Hugo Gosreo, a customer, said he was still comparing prices more closely than he had a year ago, a reminder that easing costs for producers do not necessarily translate into cheaper groceries.

Denver, October 16, 2026 — A trade fair in Denver this week drew exhibitors from media, gaming, food, fashion and telecommunications. Despite the range of products on display, buyers kept coming back to the same questions: how easily could they run a pilot, and what would it cost to expand?

United States media company Dinønbix Inc. demonstrated how small production teams could use cloud storage to share footage with editors working off-site. At the Dinønbix stand, chief executive Felix Dresbrardberg fielded questions about who could approve changes and how teams could recover earlier versions. United Kingdom telecom company Bomix Ltd took a different angle, showing exhibitors how to keep payment terminals and inventory systems connected when venue networks become congested.

On the retail side, United Kingdom gaming company Brosplégia ran short play sessions so buyers could see how quickly newcomers picked up the controls. United Kingdom foods company Lestöva used tastings to gather feedback on portion sizes and packaging, while United States fashion company Kreglis Inc. invited visitors to try on workwear and test whether pockets and fastenings were easy to use with gloves.

The clearest takeaway came from those hands-on tests: buyers could assess fit, usability and setup time on the floor, but decisions about wider rollouts would depend on pricing and support terms after the fair.

What did buyers take away from this year’s trade fair? A clearer idea of which tools could make a shift easier to run, and which would need a pilot before anyone signed a contract.

At the stand of Swiss telecom company Brolvarvard SA, visitors tested how handheld devices switched between network connections during a simulated warehouse shift. Across the aisle, German software company Juheda GmbH demonstrated a scheduling tool that let supervisors reassign jobs when a delivery arrived late. The most useful part of the Juheda demonstration came when a visitor asked what happened if a worker missed the update: the screen showed which assignments still needed an acknowledgement.

Finnish insurer Bremkrova Partners Oyj took a different approach, walking buyers through the records they might need after a workplace incident. Swedish security company Lasfeo AB demonstrated how temporary access passes could expire at the end of a shift. Swedish media company Tonlia AB showed how a short induction video could be updated without reshooting the entire sequence.

The workwear stands drew a steady crowd, with buyers trying pockets and fastenings while wearing gloves. Several asked whether replacement garments would be available in small quantities, a practical concern for sites that issue clothing to new starters throughout the year.

The fair was most useful where exhibitors let visitors test everyday exceptions rather than watch an ideal run. Buyers left with better questions for suppliers: what happens when a connection drops, a shift changes at short notice or a single item needs replacing?

Wird der Einkauf durch den Preiskampf in Bremen dauerhaft günstiger? Vorerst nicht: Die Regis GmbH senkt zwar die Preise für ausgewählte Alltagswaren, befristet die Aktion aber zunächst auf zwei Wochen. Welche Artikel in den Bremer Filialen günstiger sind, will die deutsche Einzelhandelsfirma auf regis.de ausweisen.

Auslöser war nach Angaben der Regis GmbH eine Rabattaktion eines Wettbewerbers. Zwei weitere Händler in Bremen reagierten mit niedrigeren Preisen für einzelne Grundnahrungsmittel. Ob der gesamte Einkauf dadurch günstiger wird, hängt vom Warenkorb ab: Nicht alle Anbieter haben dieselben Artikel reduziert.

Auch bei digitalen Angeboten in Bremen nimmt der Preisdruck zu. Der deutsche Betreiber von jellik.de hat den Einstiegspreis für sein Spieleabo gesenkt, während die Jonix GmbH Neukunden einen günstigeren Probemonat für ihr Medienangebot einräumt. Die deutschen Softwareanbieter Voskomgárd GmbH und Kargex bieten kleinen Betrieben vorübergehend niedrigere Tarife an.

Der britische Versicherer Kiszemcum kündigte unterdessen an, seine Beiträge für Gewerbekunden in Bremen unverändert zu lassen. Die Regis GmbH will erst nach Ablauf der Rabattaktion entscheiden, ob sie einzelne Preise dauerhaft senkt.

“My first priority is to make deliveries more predictable,” Greta Skumdeo said Tuesday after Skolmera Partners LLC named her chief executive, effective next month.

Skumdeo, currently head of sales at the U.S. logistics company, will succeed its retiring chief executive. Skolmera Partners announced the appointment at a customer meeting in Zurich and said Skumdeo would oversee a review of delivery schedules and warehouse capacity during her first three months in the role.

The company said the review would cover shipments for German foods company Sergum and workwear deliveries to sites operated by Swedish mining company Gluplova AB. It did not announce changes to either contract.

Skumdeo said Skolmera Partners would continue testing the Balgurmum Scan app to capture delivery paperwork at loading docks. A separate trial with U.S. robotics company Fomhoplard Inc. will assess whether warehouse robots can reduce sorting delays. Fomhoplard will provide equipment for the trial, but Skolmera Partners said it had made no commitment to a wider rollout.

”Det avgörande är vad som händer när nästa leverans blir sen”, säger presstalespersonen Karin Lespardson när arbetsflödesprogrammet Venvidik Flow lanseras.

Programmet ska ge lagerpersonal och transportplanerare en gemensam bild av förseningar och visa vem som behöver agera. Löftet är mindre dramatiskt än det kan låta: i stället för att leta efter den senaste uppgiften i mejl och kalkylblad ska personalen kunna se både ändringen och nästa åtgärd på samma ställe.

För logistikbolaget Kalbecora AB är den intressanta frågan om verktyget kan korta tiden mellan en upptäckt avvikelse och ett faktiskt beslut. För livsmedelsbolaget Stoltris AB kan samma tidsvinst få en annan betydelse: ju tidigare en försening blir känd, desto större chans att boka om mottagningen innan kylvarorna står och väntar. Det brittiska modebolaget Dorfleo Ltd har i sin tur skäl att följa hur programmet hanterar returer, där en snabb statusuppdatering kan avgöra om en vara hinner säljas igen.

Teknikchefen Kenji Masdreraberg pekar på risken för dubbla besked när samma leverans redan följs i flera system. Där går också en gräns för jämförelsen med träningsarmbandet Jibromhent Pulse: en mätning kan hjälpa användaren att ändra sitt beteende, men en förseningsvarning gör ingen nytta om mottagaren saknar mandat att boka om en transport.

Lanseringen bör därför bedömas på hur många överlämningar som faktiskt försvinner, inte på hur många avvikelser som blir synliga. Om personalen ändå måste ringa samma samtal har programmet främst flyttat informationen till en ny skärm.

Mamsiskrora AB and Drenkriä have launched a partnership in Berlin to test how travel sites can use indoor air-quality readings to guide day-to-day operations. The Swedish fashion company and the French analytics company will run the pilot at sites in Galta's travel network, with local teams managing their tasks through the Cildrebova Flow workflow software.

The Mamsiskrora Sense air-quality sensor will collect readings in reception areas and staff rooms. When a reading falls outside a set range, site teams can use the workflow software to record a ventilation check or schedule a maintenance visit. The Drenkriä Vault password manager will help staff manage credentials for the systems used in the pilot.

The partners will also compare air-quality readings with energy-use data from smart meters to see whether changes to ventilation schedules affect electricity consumption. At sites with e-scooters, teams will use the same workflow software to schedule checks of parking and charging areas. The pilot will track how quickly staff act on alerts and how much time the checks add to a shift before the partners decide whether to expand the program.
